title: Verify that an empty Hyperlink Title is allowed because the field is optional

steps.action: Open the About Qatar Chamber page record in Liferay CMS
steps.expected: Record opens with the Hyperlink Title field empty

steps.action: Leave the Hyperlink Title field empty, complete all mandatory fields, and click Publish
steps.expected: Publish succeeds with no validation error against Hyperlink Title and the success toast is shown

steps.action: Open the About Qatar Chamber page in English
steps.expected: The page renders its content normally with no empty or broken link label displayed

title: Verify that a valid Hyperlink URL is accepted and saved

steps.action: Open the About Qatar Chamber page record in Liferay CMS
steps.expected: Record opens with the Hyperlink URL field available

steps.action: Enter 'https://www.qatarchamber.com' as the Hyperlink URL and click Save
steps.expected: Value is accepted with no validation error and the success toast is shown

title: Verify that an empty Hyperlink URL is allowed because the field is optional

steps.action: Open the About Qatar Chamber page record in Liferay CMS
steps.expected: Record opens with the Hyperlink URL field empty

steps.action: Leave the Hyperlink URL field empty, complete all mandatory fields, and click Publish
steps.expected: Publish succeeds with no validation error against Hyperlink URL and the success toast is shown

steps.action: Open the About Qatar Chamber page in English
steps.expected: The page renders normally with no anchor pointing to an empty or malformed destination

title: Verify that the Status dropdown offers and stores the Draft value

steps.action: Open the About Qatar Chamber page record in Liferay CMS
steps.expected: Record opens with the Status dropdown available

steps.action: Open the Status dropdown and select Draft, then click Save
steps.expected: The dropdown lists Draft and Published; Draft is selected and saved with the success toast shown

title: Verify that the Status dropdown offers and stores the Published value

steps.action: Open the About Qatar Chamber page record in Liferay CMS with Status currently Draft
Open the Status dropdown and select Published, then click Save
steps.expected: Published is selected and saved with the success toast shown
